name: John
source: John is a struggling musician known to be arrogant, moody, and egotistical---and damn proud of it. he learned to play the saxophone at a very young age from his father, and believes himself to be as good (and better than) his idol and namesake, John Coltraine. John loves being with people that help feed his ego, which is why he's often found alone, playing jazz at the Brooks cafe.
